_comment: HLD test 18 throughput baseline. CI gate fires if measured throughput < threshold_pct * baseline. Update manually when an intentional perf change lands; do NOT auto-update (silent baseline drift defeats the gate's purpose).
_calibration_notes: Calibration history. (1) 2026-05-10 (v0.1): 250-sample x 20K-variant x 2-panel fixture (10M genotypes). Initial baseline measured 31.9M g/s on `ubuntu-latest`; conservative baseline pinned at 25M g/s. (2) 2026-05-12 (v0.3.1): fixture bumped to 500 x 100K x 2 (100M genotypes, 10x larger). The smaller fixture was insufficient to surface the v0.3 hot-path vectorization wins — at 20K variants, fixed overhead (synth, pandas join, RSS measurement) dwarfed the per-row-loop savings. At 100K variants per panel, pass-1 alignment and pass-2 placement dominate, so any future regression in those code paths is detectable. Baseline retained at 25M g/s until the next CI run produces a calibrated number; a follow-up commit will bump it to ~0.9x of the measured throughput on the v0.3 codebase (leaves ~10% noise margin for runner variance).
